page.overview:
Who is Cosmic Owl?

The Cosmic Owl is a cosmic entity known to the inhabitants of Ooo for appearing in Premonition dreams. He seemed to have a young, rural-type accent at first, but spoke with a voice like that of an elderly man from "Jake the Dog" onward. Initially mysterious, the episode "Hoots" revealed that he was a lonely individual.

He was briefly killed by Huntress Wizard and was resurrected by his brother, the Karmic Worm. The Cosmic Owl later abandoned his post in front of his peers, resulting in him being marked a criminal.

As revealed in "The Bird in the Clock", he was once one of two prankster brothers living on the fringes of the cosmos, at the dawn of most things. One day, their jokes went too far. They ate an ethereal pizza that they had been strictly forbidden to touch.

After defying this prohibition, one of the brothers betrayed the other to escape punishment. The punishment was terrible and eternal: the accused brother vanished into oblivion, while the traitor was transformed into a cosmic entity, condemned to wander through dreams. Thus was born the Cosmic Owl, messenger of destiny, whose every appearance in a dream foretells an inevitable future.
